name: NO20
variant: Cogent thin non-oriented, 0.20 mm, fully processed, as sheared

provenance.source: Cogent brochure 'Electrical Steel Thin Non Oriented' (NO12 / NO18 / NO20, Cogent Power, Corus/SSAB era), docs/sources/materials/cogent_thin_non_oriented_NO12_NO18_NO20.pdf, pp. 6-7 'Typical magnetization curve (D.C.)': H at J = 0.1 ... 1.8 T, one table for NO12/18/20. Stored as B = J + mu0 H. 25 cm Epstein frame, IEC 60404-4 DC permeameter, half the strips rolling direction and half transverse, as sheared, not aged or stress-relief annealed. Typical, not guaranteed. The current Tata Steel Hi-Lite NO20-1200H datasheet was not reachable for download.

stacking_factor_source: PROVISIONAL: the Cogent brochure gives no stacking factor; 0.95 is a placeholder until the supplier states one
saturation_polarisation_source: PROVISIONAL: typical value for Fe-3%Si-0.4%Al non-oriented steel (brochure composition Si 3.0 %, Al 0.4 %); the brochure states no Js
